items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Implements exactly the 5 ACs; spec-reviewer independently confirmed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: marker_key handles non-dict payload, non-str fields, empty strings; fail-open preserved from prior logic.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: agent_id sanitized via whitelist regex ([^A-Za-z0-9_-]) before use in a filename, preventing path traversal via a crafted agent_id.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests exercise the real subprocess hook scripts end-to-end (outcomes, not internals); two pure-function unit tests of marker_key are appropriate since it is a pure helper.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops/DB/IO beyond a single small JSON file read/write, unchanged from prior implementation.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: bloat_baseline.py trimmed to exactly 300 lines by extracting marker_key into new bloat_marker_key.py (48 lines); both hook scripts stayed at 295/299 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer (check_file_size.py) / consumer (bloat_gate_on_stop.py) pair identified for bloat_pending.<key>.json; real writer-to-real-reader integration test (test_orchestrator_stop_ignores_inflight_subagent_marker) proves composition, matching the exact reported bug repro.
